lines.1: 「Ooh! Once we're through the tunnel... What was it again?」
lines.4: 「Hey, Fukahire. This year's hotel is decent, right?」
lines.5: 「Last year you cheaped out. When that huge bug crawled out of the drawer, I seriously had no idea what to do.」
lines.6: 「Leave it to me. I picked a good hotel this year.」
lines.7: 「Going to hit on girls on the slopes again?」
lines.8: 「Obviously! What do you think I'm going there for?」
lines.10: 「If you snag some girl who looks loaded, let me know.」
lines.14: 「None of us got a partner this year either, huh.」
lines.15: Clack, clack. The train rocked along the tracks.
lines.16: Right now, it was carrying us farther and farther north through Tohoku.
lines.17: 「That's weird. I've been trying my ass off, too--following girls I like until I find out where they live and stuff.」
lines.19: 「That's your problem. Your ulterior motives are way too obvious.」
lines.20: 「This is bad. I'm starting to feel desperate.」
lines.21: 「That desperation's only going to make you lose even harder.」
lines.23: 「Says Crab, who keeps shooting down every confession she gets.」
lines.24: 「I'm fine. Being single and carefree suits me.」
lines.25: 「Besides, none of them are anything like my ideal guy.」
lines.26: 「More like you're a ton of work.」
lines.27: 「In a way, the guys you reject are the lucky ones.」
lines.28: 「Don't talk about me like I'm some little animal!」
lines.29: 「Hah. If I'm such a handful, I'll keep causing you trouble forever. Serves you right.」
lines.32: 「Sure, none of us found anyone, but isn't this good in its own way?」
lines.33: 「It'd be lonely if any one of us were missing.」
lines.34: 「Tch. Easy for you to say when you're so relaxed about it.」
lines.35: 「...Two-dimensional girls don't have flesh, so they aren't warm.」
lines.36: 「Yeah, but don't they warm your heart anyway?」
lines.37: 「Even that only goes so far. I miss human warmth.」
lines.43: 「Next time let's go by car! We can stop at rest areas and eat local specialties everywhere we go!」
lines.44: 「Then you can't buy those station bento boxes you love so much.」
lines.45: 「Ugh. That might be a little rough.」
lines.46: 「Still, a car would be convenient. Subaru, you're driving.」
lines.47: 「You don't have to ask. I'll drive. Letting any of you behind the wheel would scare the hell out of me.」
lines.48: 「What are we doing about the car itself?」
lines.49: 「Either rent one or buy something cheap.」
lines.50: 「Fukahire, sell an organ. Your heart'll do.」
lines.51: 「Don't say that to someone who's supposed to be your friend!」
lines.52: 「Haha... You guys never run out of energy.」
lines.53: For some reason, Subaru looked on happily as Fukahire and Crab bickered.
lines.54: That's right. They were my childhood friends--and my friends, too.
lines.55: They could be pretty rotten, but I honestly thought they were good guys.
lines.56: We'd been hanging out together forever.
lines.58: Would it stay that way from here on out?
lines.59: Honestly, that would make me happy.
lines.60: I didn't need a mountain of friends.
lines.61: As long as I had these guys who understood me.
lines.62: That was why I was happy.
lines.63: The train rolled on down the tracks.
lines.65: But someday, we might all go our separate ways.
lines.66: So I wanted to treasure this little stretch of time when we could still act like idiots.
lines.67: Still childhood friends, carrying on like a bunch of kids.
